comment: Hono 4 on Node 26 through @hono/node-server, one module per family under Implementation/routes, each registering its routes on one application, in TypeScript that Node runs without a build step. The suite is UnitTests/, node:test over Hono's app.request(), and never reaches the image. install-ci-test is npm ci then npm test, because the suite needs node_modules and the typechecker. upgrade is npm update, which moves package-lock.json within the ranges package.json states. hono/compress gzips through CompressionStream, which takes no level, so the compressed rows are at zlib's default level, 6, where the other frameworks compress at their fastest. There is no Client/: Hono writes an OpenAPI document only for routes written with @hono/zod-openapi's createRoute.

noHandler.cors.preflight: hono/cors answers the preflight itself on every path under /cors, and no handler runs.
noHandler.errors.unmatched: Hono's default not-found handler answers a path no route matches with 404.
noHandler.errors.wrong_method: The router matches the method and the path together, so a method the path has no route for reaches the default not-found handler, which answers 404.

authorized.mechanism: Middleware on the route that compares the bearer token, and refuses any other by throwing Hono's HTTPException with 403

baseline.builtin: The handler returns c.text(), which Hono sends as text/plain.

body.mechanism: zValidator from @hono/zod-validator on each validate route, which runs a zod schema on the parsed body before the handler. The first-error route runs it one field at a time

cache.mechanism: hono/cache on each route, over the part of the Web Cache API it calls, written for Node as a Map that holds settings.json's capacity for its TTL

compressed.mechanism: hono/compress on each route, at its default threshold. It gzips through CompressionStream, which takes no level, so at zlib's default level, 6

errors.builtin: Hono's default not-found handler answers a miss and the items handlers' c.notFound() with 404, and its default error handler writes the validator's HTTPException for a body that is not JSON with 400, each as text/plain.

etag.mechanism: hono/etag on each route, which hashes the body with SHA-1 and answers a matching If-None-Match with 304

forms.mechanism: zValidator's form target binds the urlencoded body by query.many's schema, and c.req.parseBody() reads the upload

headers.mechanism: zValidator's header target, with a zod schema that converts the account to an integer

items.builtin: One route per method on /items/:id, the id converted by zValidator's param target. Hono answers HEAD with the GET route.

json.builtin: The handler returns c.json(), which Hono writes with JSON.stringify.

middleware.mechanism: No-op middleware given on the route before its handler, four or sixteen of them

parameters.mechanism: zValidator's param target, with a zod schema that converts each capture to an integer

query.mechanism: zValidator's query target, with a zod schema that converts the numbers to integers

sse.mechanism: streamSSE from hono/streaming, which writes each row as one event

static.mechanism: serveStatic from @hono/node-server over the payload directory, under /static/

stream.builtin: The handler writes each line through stream() from hono/streaming, and the answer goes out chunked.

template.mechanism: html from hono/html, a tagged template that escapes what it interpolates, sent by c.html()
